newsitem.title: USA: Standard Products names Roudebush CEO.
newsitem.headline: Standard Products names Roudebush CEO.

text.p: Standard Products Co said it named Ronald Roudebush vice chairman and chief executive officer, as well as a member of the board.
His formal election to the three positions will take place when directors meet July 24, the 1997, said the auto parts manufacturer.
Roudebush replaces James Reid as chief executive.
Reid will remain chairman of the board, Standard said.
Theodore Zampetis, will remain president and chief operating officer, it said.
Roudebush for the past two years has been the owner of a retail automobile dealership in Cincinnati.
